entities.name: USER CONSUMER TV
entities.rationale: Smart TV / Consumer TV client device streaming telemetry data.

entities.name: KINESIS DATA STREAMS
entities.rationale: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams ingesting real-time video/telemetry streams from Consumer TV.

entities.name: KINESIS FIREHOSE
entities.rationale: Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivering streaming data to S3 and Redshift.

entities.name: AMAZON S3
entities.rationale: Amazon S3 bucket receiving raw data stream from Kinesis Firehose.

entities.name: AMAZON REDSHIFT
entities.rationale: Amazon Redshift data warehouse receiving loaded data from Kinesis Firehose and feeding QuickSight.

entities.name: AMAZON QUICKSIGHT
entities.rationale: Amazon QuickSight business intelligence tool visualizing analytics from Redshift.

visual_connections.description: User Consumer TV streams data to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams.
Kinesis Data Streams passes stream records to Kinesis Firehose.
Kinesis Firehose delivers data to Amazon S3 bucket.
Kinesis Firehose loads streaming data into Amazon Redshift.
Amazon Redshift feeds analytical datasets into Amazon QuickSight.
